workflow_description: Handles the initialization of tables from various data structures like POCOs, dictionaries, or arrays and ensures data integrity by validating row counts against defined columns.
integration_test: [Fact] public void Verify_Table_Data_Population_And_Validation_Workflow() { var manualTable = new ConsoleTable("Col1", "Col2"); manualTable.AddRow("Value1", "Value2"); var validationException = Assert.Throws<Exception>(() => manualTable.AddRow("OnlyOneValue")); Assert.Contains("does not match", validationException.Message); var users = new List<User> { new User { Name = "Integration Test", Age = 10 } }; var pocoTable = ConsoleTable.From(users); Assert.Equal(2, pocoTable.Columns.Count); Assert.Contains("Name", pocoTable.Columns); Assert.Contains("Age", pocoTable.Columns); var dictData = new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, object>> { { "HeaderKey", new Dictionary<string, object> { { "DataKey", "DataValue" } } } }; var dictTable = ConsoleTable.FromDictionary(dictData); Assert.Equal("", dictTable.Columns[0]); Assert.Equal("DataKey", dictTable.Columns[1]); Assert.Equal("HeaderKey", dictTable.Rows[0][0]); Object[][] arrayData = [ ["HeaderA", "HeaderB"], ["ValueA", "ValueB"] ]; var arrayTable = ConsoleTable.From(arrayData); Assert.Equal("HeaderA", arrayTable.Columns[0]); Assert.Equal("ValueA", arrayTable.Rows[0][0]); DataTable dataTable = new DataTable(); dataTable.Columns.Add("DtCol", typeof(string)); dataTable.Rows.Add("DtValue"); var dtTable = ConsoleTable.From(dataTable); Assert.Single(dtTable.Columns); Assert.Equal("DtCol", dtTable.Columns[0]); Assert.Equal("DtValue", dtTable.Rows[0][0]); }

workflow_description: Defines the table's presentation layer, including format styles, Unicode-aware alignment calculations, and specialized alignment for specific data types.
integration_test: [Fact] public void VisualStylingAndAlignmentConfiguration_FullWorkflow_Test() { var users = new List<User> { new User { Name = "Alexandre", Age = 36 }, new User { Name = "Lucía 👩", Age = 28 } }; var table = ConsoleTable.From(users).Configure(o => { o.NumberAlignment = Alignment.Right; o.EnableCount = true; }); string defaultTable = table.ToString(); Assert.Contains("| Alexandre |  36 |", defaultTable); Assert.Contains("| Lucía 👩  |  28 |", defaultTable); Assert.Contains("Count: 2", defaultTable); string markdownTable = table.ToMarkDownString(); Assert.Contains("| Name      | Age |", markdownTable); Assert.Contains("|-----------|-----|", markdownTable); Assert.Contains("| Alexandre |  36 |", markdownTable); string alternativeTable = table.ToStringAlternative(); Assert.Contains("+-----------+-----+", alternativeTable); string minimalTable = table.ToMinimalString(); Assert.Contains("Name       Age", minimalTable); Assert.Contains("Alexandre   36", minimalTable); using (var sw = new StringWriter()) { table.Configure(o => o.OutputTo = sw); table.Write(Format.Minimal); var output = sw.ToString(); Assert.Equal(minimalTable + Environment.NewLine, output); } }
